in_hebrew.name: Helm
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Helm הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘helm’, meaning helmet or protection. Used in various Germanic languages, such as Old Norse ‘helmi’, and Old English ‘helmian’, meaning to shield or protect.

in_greek.name: Helm
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Helmet, protection
in_greek.long_meaning: Helm είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ‘helm’, meaning helmet or protection. Used in various Germanic languages, such as Old Norse ‘helmi’, and Old English ‘helmian’, meaning to shield or protect.

in_latin.name: Helm
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Helmet, protection
in_latin.long_meaning: Helm est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English ‘helm’, meaning helmet or protection. Used in various Germanic languages, such as Old Norse ‘helmi’, and Old English ‘helmian’, meaning to shield or protect.
